name: appliances
description: Generic `flags.plugged_in` gate for any powered furniture (power_draw_kw set) — owns `unplug <name>` plus a shared 'looks broken' examine hook when unplugged; the inverse `plug <name>` arrives via the generator plugin's fallback to togglePluggedByName(). Absent flag = plugged in, for backward compatibility. Consumed by vending and preservation.
